verdict.rationale: Lever's first-party developer documentation has dedicated webhook sections: setting up webhooks, securing them, receiving them, event payloads, event configuration, and responding to a webhook. That indicates registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer can subscribe to by event. The evidence is only section headings, so the depth is not shown. Missing for 10: detailed content on the supported event types and the registration mechanics (UI vs API), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the webhooks work as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
